whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fit 2 Pro,

I noticed your gym is actively operating in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online membership inquiries and trial bookings.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://fit2pro.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Fit 2 Pro, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness center ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for clients in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
